question: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited is an Indian rural non-banking financial company headquartered in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mumbai__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited (MMFSL) is an Indian rural non-banking financial company headquartered in Mumbai.**
 
• It is amongst the top tractor financers in India, with 1000+ offices across the country.
 
• Mahindra Finance **started on 1 January 1991, as Maxi Motors Financial Services Limited**.
 
• They **received the certificate of commencement of business on 19 February 1991.**
 
• On **3 November 1992, Mahindra Finance changed its name **to Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited.
